This invocation produces exactly ONE independent R7-D1-M1 poster, assigned portrait width:height 2:3.
COMMON COORDINATOR CONSTRAINTS:
[
  "Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.",
  "No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.",
  "Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.",
  "The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.",
  "Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.",
  "Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation."

DESIGN SPEC — precise-object-edit of the supplied own initial poster. Exactly one finished flat opaque portrait 2:3 poster.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Edit target Image 1 is this role's own returned initial poster. It has been inspected. Correct the observed title geometry ONLY: the existing title leans/skews as if printed in pavement perspective. Re-render “서로 다른 속도” exactly once as completely upright, unwarped 2D graphic poster typography at its present lower-middle scene location. Remove the old skewed title completely and replace it, never duplicate it. Preserve all six Hangul syllables and precisely the original two word spaces. A calm medium-weight contemporary sans-serif with normal square syllable proportions, open counters, consistent glyph scale, conventional spacing. Every vertical stroke is truly vertical to the image canvas, every horizontal stroke is truly horizontal, and all syllables share ONE LEVEL HORIZONTAL BASELINE. NO italic, slant, perspective foreshortening, rotation, varying letter angle, flattened glyphs, calligraphic warp, ground paint, embossing, extrusion or shadow. Dark charcoal, sharp clean edges. The lettering is a stationary observation overlay in the photographed shared ground area; it does NOT follow the perspective of the pavement. Slightly increase the clean title's apparent height if necessary to maintain its original visual prominence. Keep safe separation from the shoes and moving blur.

Keep the existing observational photographic scene, framing, viewpoint and bodily relation. One navy-clothed adult is still and sharp on the left, visibly settled on a planted foot; one rust-clothed adult strides from left to right with sustained coherent directional motion blur on the right, in the same continuous pedestrian concourse and captured moment. Their substantial bodies, unequal movement and foot contact must continue to survive thumbnail viewing independently of the title. Preserve both full-body silhouettes, shoe visibility, naturally occluded hands, consistent light and shadows, dry concrete, low wall, cloth/skin/shoe material differences and the realistic restrained paving detail. Do not move the passer farther toward the right edge, clip either person's feet, change wardrobe colors or introduce other people/objects.

The title remains close to the paused figure and passing trajectory, in the lower-middle open pavement with substantial continuous ground below. No remote header, footer caption, artificial band or text box. Keep the quiet bodily contrast as the first recognition, a completely sharp title as a stable observation point, and selective movement blur beside it. No global blur, montage, decorative ribbons, cloned ghost figures, glamour light, new texture/filter, labels, logos or incidental text. All depicted clothing, objects and surfaces are unbranded. No extra copy, marks, numbers, watermark or border. Output only one single completed flat opaque poster.
